historical_evidence.interpretation: The 0.9.1 manifests, source hashes, command counts, stage counts, and transcripts remain historical evidence. They are not rewritten to claim a 0.9.2 rerun.

editorial_policy.rule: User and administrator DITA must not expose documentation-toolchain or generic maintainer test commands when the normal product entry point already refreshes the documentation.

current_source_contract.current_topic_interpretation: The compact 0.9.2 topics retain the deploy, migration, start, readiness, Library, stop, and rollback path. `make dev` refreshes the developer documentation through `docs-install-dev`; the current DITA is not represented as a repeat of the immutable 0.9.1 container transcript.

wsl_interpretation: The prepared 0.9.1 WSL runner and its unverified Windows outcome records retain their historical source fingerprint. A future Windows-host run must select the current compact source topic and create new evidence rather than mutating the 0.9.1 record.
